axes.label: Friendly Bleed, Curse, or Disease removal

notes: Naturalize removes Magic Paralyzing Shots, Cauterizing Flame removes Disease Regurgitate, and Overawe removes Ravenous Claws' Enrage.
The live guide's Altar subsection contains stale unrelated examples; WHELP uses only dungeon-matched canonical mechanics.
Naturalize removes the canonical Magic debuff Spore Spines. The source fragment naming Muro'jin, Nekraxx, and their mechanics belongs to Maisara Caverns and is rejected here.
No independently corroborated Blinding Vale Bleed, Curse, Disease, or Enrage target is currently modeled.
Cauterizing Flame provides the guide's Curse answer; no current Enrage target is modeled.
Zephyr applies only to area damage, while Time Dilation staggers damage on one ally and does not count as party mitigation.
Naturalize removes friendly Magic effects, while Cauterizing Flame covers eligible Bleeds and Curse of Doom without removing Magic.
The current guide identifies Ephemeral Bloodlust as an Overawe target and Throw Axe as a Cauterizing Flame target.
Naturalize removes player Magic debuffs such as Fire Spit or Melt Armor; Quell interrupts Violent Sand.
Cauterizing Flame does not remove Magic. The guide's Bleed and Enrage suggestions remain unjoined where canonical spell IDs are absent.
Naturalize handles Magic and Poison effects; Quell covers priority casts, while Tail Swipe, Wing Buffet, and Sleep Walk stop susceptible channels.
Mechanics from an unrelated dungeon misplaced in this guide subsection are intentionally excluded.
Naturalize, Cauterizing Flame, and Quell cover distinct friendly-dispel and interrupt domains; Sleep Walk has limited value against Undead.
Do not remove Ancestral Fury simply because Overawe can Soothe it: its linked vulnerability benefits group damage.
Naturalize retains healer dispel value, but the current guide's unrelated-instance cleanse and Enrage examples are excluded.
Quell, control, Zephyr, Time Dilation, and movement support remain generally useful without unsupported mechanic joins.

recommendations: Quell covers one cast while Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet stop clustered orbs; the latter remain crowd-control rather than school interrupts.
No dedicated utility shortcut is sourced; contribute damage while maintaining healing coverage.
Time Spiral, Spatial Paradox, and Rescue offer distinct partner-movement support; respect the Time Spiral and Spatial Paradox choice node.
Naturalize removes Magic or Poison shields and Cauterizing Flame removes eligible non-Magic shields; neither substitutes for the other domains.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of Voulk's Patch 12.1.0 Preservation dungeon and affix guidance, excluding misplaced unrelated-dungeon fragments and joining only canonical spell identities.
